name: runc-setns-exception
description: setns(2) invoked by runc (OCI container runtime) during container creation. runc legitimately calls setns to enter the container's namespaces during the create/start lifecycle. Even though enrichment.container_id is resolved (runc operates in the container's cgroup context), the process.exec_path exception for /usr/bin/runc suppresses the alert. Expect no match.
